text:
alyssa: quick flag  preview invoice alert for a small cohort at ~03:12 UTC. Deltas look like double-counted tokens in invoice preview, not in canonical invoices

sam: investigating logs. initial hypothesis: some ingest events emitted provisional metering without epoch, then later emitted final with epoch -> preview shows both entries

mira: can you dump an example? want to see ordering and fields

sam: sample:
INFO 2026-03-22T03:12:01Z ingest request_id=ri_8a2 epoch_id=null route=embed-heavy tokens=129
INFO 2026-03-22T03:12:02Z joiner commit request_id=ri_8a2 epoch_id=epoch-20260322-03 tokens=129

jordan: that pattern will create two preview line items since dedupe runs async. final invoices dedupe later so customers don't actually pay twice, but preview UI is confusing

alyssa: console UX team is getting complaints. can we suppress provisional items in preview until final commit?

mira: suppressing may hide useful early telemetry for some customers. maybe expose per-route "billing-consistent-mode" to trade small latency for cleaner previews

sam: implementation idea: edge-proxy can wait a short window (e.g., 20-100ms) for epoch assignment before emitting provisional event. If epoch still unknown, emit but mark provisional. Then metering-preview pipeline hides provisional if a final arrives within N minutes

jordan: also need to handle retries where request_id changes. add client_request_id passthrough and use (request_id, client_request_id) as dedupe key

alyssa: short term: console-side filter that collapses preview items where a final commit appears within 5m and shares client_request_id. Low-risk and reversible

mira: I'll draft modal copy and add a toggle in route settings. Wording: "Enable billing-consistent-mode: small p50 latency increase (~5-25ms) for reduced duplicate preview items and steadier invoice previews."

sam: telemetry changes: add counters metering.provisional_emitted, metering.duplicate_preview_count, metering.provisional_wait_ms. Edge PR behind feature flag ingest.bump/provisional_epoch

jordan: metering-ingest will need dedupe-before-preview logic and e2e that simulates late-join ordering. Ill add tests for both request_id and client_request_id matching

ops-bot: INC-4821 muted alerts for tenant cohort while mitigation patches roll out

alyssa: owners? mira -> console filter + UX copy. sam -> edge-proxy wait + telemetry. jordan -> ingest dedupe + tests. I'll coordinate canary windows

mira: linking PR for modal mockups and console toggle doc when ready

sam: PR: https://git.redwood.company/edge-proxy/pulls/812 (WIP)

jordan: PR: https://git.redwood.company/metering-ingest/pulls/129 (WIP)
